chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
It is sufficient as condolence that the person afflicted by the calamity sees you.

key_terms.التَّعْزِيَةِ: offering condolences and consolation to someone in grief
key_terms.الْمُصِيبَةِ: the affliction, calamity, or bereavement that has struck someone
key_terms.صَاحِبُ: the person experiencing or bearing something
key_terms.يَرَاكَ: sees you; your visible presence before the bereaved person

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum sufficient form of condolence for a bereaved person in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches that sincere presence itself can be an adequate form of condolence for one struck by grief. The hadith emphasizes compassion, social support, and the comfort conveyed simply by showing up for the bereaved.
